claim: You can use AWS Backup Vault Lock to prevent anyone (including you) from deleting backups or altering their retention period, which helps enforce a write-once-read-many (WORM) model; vaults locked in governance mode, however, can have the lock removed by users with sufficient IAM permissions.

qualifiers.condition: a governance-mode lock can be removed by users with sufficient IAM permissions

evidence.quote: You can use AWS Backup Vault Lock to prevent anyone (including you) from deleting backups or altering their retention period. AWS Backup Vault Lock helps you enforce a write-once-read-many (WORM) model and add another layer of defense to your defense in depth.
Vaults locked in **governance mode** can have the lock removed by users with sufficient IAM permissions.
